Container.Name: Glovebox
Container.Overview: Glovebox is a redesigned LubeLogger: a self-hosted vehicle maintenance tracker focused on what's coming up next, with a mobile-first interface, rendered markdown notes, an in-app attachment viewer and ntfy push notifications for reminders (with an adjustable heads-up before things are due).[br][br]It uses the same data format as LubeLogger. To switch an existing LubeLogger container, keep your path mappings exactly as they are and only change the Repository to ghcr.io/au12/glovebox:latest.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, photos, attachments, translations and settings. Point this at your existing LubeLogger data folder to keep everything.

Config.Name: Sign-in keys
Config.Description: Encryption keys for sign-in cookies. Reuse your existing folder so everyone stays signed in.

Config.Name: LANG
Config.Description: Locale for dates, numbers and currency, for example en_US.UTF-8 or en_GB.UTF-8.

Config.Name: Server URL (optional)
Config.Description: The address you use to reach Glovebox, for example https://glovebox.example.com. Used for links in emails and notifications.
